description: Risk classification system for DeFi lending positions including LTV levels, health factor ranges, and liquidation thresholds

ultra_safe.description: Extremely conservative position with massive liquidation buffer
ultra_safe.recommendation: Position is very safe. Can consider increasing utilization if seeking higher returns.

safe.description: Healthy position with substantial buffer against market volatility
safe.recommendation: Good balance of capital efficiency and safety. Monitor during high volatility.

moderate.description: Moderate risk position requiring active monitoring
moderate.recommendation: Set up liquidation alerts. Consider reducing exposure in volatile markets.

aggressive.description: High-risk position close to danger zone
aggressive.recommendation: Actively monitor. Prepare to repay debt or add collateral. Not recommended for volatile assets.

danger.recommendation: IMMEDIATE ACTION REQUIRED. Repay debt or add collateral NOW.

liquidatable.recommendation: Emergency: Position is being or will be liquidated. Act immediately if possible.

health_factor_classification.description: Health Factor interpretation with 5 levels for agent response behavior

safe.description: Position is healthy with strong buffer against liquidation

sample_response.en: Your position is healthy! Health Factor of {hf} means you have a strong safety margin. Your collateral would need to drop by approximately {drop_pct}% before reaching liquidation risk.
sample_response.es: Su posicion esta saludable! Factor de Salud de {hf} significa que tiene un margen de seguridad solido. Su colateral tendria que caer aproximadamente {drop_pct}% antes de alcanzar riesgo de liquidacion.
sample_response.pt: Sua posicao esta saudavel! Fator de Saude de {hf} significa que voce tem uma margem de seguranca solida. Seu colateral precisaria cair aproximadamente {drop_pct}% antes de atingir risco de liquidacao.
sample_response.zh: 您的仓位是健康的！健康因子 {hf} 意味着您有强大的安全边际。您的抵押品需要下跌约 {drop_pct}% 才会面临清算风险。

caution.description: Position requires attention during volatile markets
caution.agent_behavior: Warning tone, recommend alerts and monitoring

sample_response.en: Your Health Factor of {hf} is in the CAUTION zone. While not immediately dangerous, I recommend monitoring your position during volatile periods. Set alerts at HF = 1.3 for early warning.
sample_response.es: Su Factor de Salud de {hf} esta en la zona de PRECAUCION. Aunque no es inmediatamente peligroso, recomiendo monitorear su posicion durante periodos volatiles. Configure alertas en HF = 1.3 para advertencia temprana.
sample_response.pt: Seu Fator de Saude de {hf} esta na zona de CUIDADO. Embora nao seja imediatamente perigoso, recomendo monitorar sua posicao durante periodos volateis. Configure alertas em HF = 1.3 para aviso antecipado.
sample_response.zh: 您的健康因子 {hf} 处于注意区域。虽然不是立即危险，但我建议在波动期间监控您的仓位。在 HF = 1.3 时设置警报以获得预警。

danger.description: Position at elevated risk - action recommended
danger.agent_behavior: Urgent tone, calculate exact repayment amounts

sample_response.en: WARNING: Your Health Factor of {hf} is in the DANGER zone. A {drop_pct}% price drop would trigger liquidation. I strongly recommend repaying at least ${repay_amount} to improve your position to HF > 1.5.
sample_response.es: ADVERTENCIA: Su Factor de Salud de {hf} esta en la zona de PELIGRO. Una caida de precio del {drop_pct}% desencadenaria la liquidacion. Recomiendo fuertemente pagar al menos ${repay_amount} para mejorar su posicion a HF > 1.5.
sample_response.pt: AVISO: Seu Fator de Saude de {hf} esta na zona de PERIGO. Uma queda de preco de {drop_pct}% desencadearia a liquidacao. Recomendo fortemente pagar pelo menos ${repay_amount} para melhorar sua posicao para HF > 1.5.
sample_response.zh: 警告：您的健康因子 {hf} 处于危险区域。价格下跌 {drop_pct}% 将触发清算。我强烈建议至少偿还 ${repay_amount} 以将您的仓位改善至 HF > 1.5。

critical.agent_behavior: Emergency tone, one-click repayment option, skip educational content

sample_response.en: CRITICAL: Your Health Factor is {hf}. Liquidation can occur at any moment. IMMEDIATE ACTION: Repay ${repay_amount} NOW to reach safety. [Execute Repayment]
sample_response.es: CRITICO: Su Factor de Salud es {hf}. La liquidacion puede ocurrir en cualquier momento. ACCION INMEDIATA: Pague ${repay_amount} AHORA para alcanzar seguridad. [Ejecutar Pago]
sample_response.pt: CRITICO: Seu Fator de Saude e {hf}. A liquidacao pode ocorrer a qualquer momento. ACAO IMEDIATA: Pague ${repay_amount} AGORA para alcancar seguranca. [Executar Pagamento]
sample_response.zh: 紧急：您的健康因子是 {hf}。清算可能随时发生。立即行动：现在偿还 ${repay_amount} 以达到安全状态。[执行还款]

liquidatable.agent_behavior: Crisis tone, explain options for remaining collateral

sample_response.en: Your position is LIQUIDATABLE with HF = {hf}. Liquidators may seize your collateral at any moment. If you still have time, repay ${repay_amount} immediately. If already liquidated, I can help you understand what happened.
sample_response.es: Su posicion es LIQUIDABLE con HF = {hf}. Los liquidadores pueden tomar su colateral en cualquier momento. Si aun tiene tiempo, pague ${repay_amount} inmediatamente. Si ya fue liquidado, puedo ayudarle a entender lo que paso.
sample_response.pt: Sua posicao e LIQUIDAVEL com HF = {hf}. Os liquidantes podem tomar seu colateral a qualquer momento. Se ainda tiver tempo, pague ${repay_amount} imediatamente. Se ja foi liquidado, posso ajuda-lo a entender o que aconteceu.
sample_response.zh: 您的仓位可被清算，HF = {hf}。清算者可能随时没收您的抵押品。如果您还有时间，请立即偿还 ${repay_amount}。如果已被清算，我可以帮助您了解发生了什么。

liquidation_thresholds_by_asset.description: Liquidation thresholds and bonuses by asset for Aave V3 and Morpho

price_drop_scenarios.description: Standard price drop scenarios for risk assessment

repayment_calculator.description: Formula for calculating minimum repayment to reach target health factor

borrow_blocked.en: Borrow blocked: Would result in HF {new_hf} (minimum required: 1.2)
borrow_blocked.es: Prestamo bloqueado: Resultaria en HF {new_hf} (minimo requerido: 1.2)
borrow_blocked.pt: Emprestimo bloqueado: Resultaria em HF {new_hf} (minimo requerido: 1.2)
borrow_blocked.zh: 借款被阻止：将导致 HF {new_hf}（最低要求：1.2）

withdraw_blocked.en: Withdrawal blocked: Would result in HF {new_hf} (minimum required: 1.3)
withdraw_blocked.es: Retiro bloqueado: Resultaria en HF {new_hf} (minimo requerido: 1.3)
withdraw_blocked.pt: Retirada bloqueada: Resultaria em HF {new_hf} (minimo requerido: 1.3)
withdraw_blocked.zh: 提款被阻止：将导致 HF {new_hf}（最低要求：1.3）

leverage_warning.trigger: User requests leverage or loop strategy

message.en: WARNING: Leverage amplifies both gains AND losses. Your position can be liquidated if collateral value drops. Only proceed if you understand and accept these risks.
message.es: ADVERTENCIA: El apalancamiento amplifica tanto las ganancias COMO las perdidas. Su posicion puede ser liquidada si el valor del colateral cae. Solo proceda si entiende y acepta estos riesgos.
message.pt: AVISO: A alavancagem amplifica tanto os ganhos QUANTO as perdas. Sua posicao pode ser liquidada se o valor do colateral cair. So prossiga se voce entende e aceita esses riscos.
message.zh: 警告：杠杆会放大收益和损失。如果抵押品价值下跌，您的仓位可能会被清算。只有在理解并接受这些风险的情况下才能继续。

message.en: Before your first lending transaction: Start with a small amount, verify contract addresses, understand you can lose funds if liquidated, keep reserves for gas fees.
message.es: Antes de su primera transaccion de prestamo: Comience con una cantidad pequena, verifique las direcciones de contrato, entienda que puede perder fondos si es liquidado, mantenga reservas para tarifas de gas.
message.pt: Antes da sua primeira transacao de emprestimo: Comece com uma quantia pequena, verifique os enderecos de contrato, entenda que voce pode perder fundos se for liquidado, mantenha reservas para taxas de gas.
message.zh: 在您第一次借贷交易之前：从小额开始，验证合约地址，了解如果被清算可能会损失资金，保留gas费储备。

message.en: You're about to supply more than 50% of your {asset} balance. Consider keeping reserves for gas and emergencies.
message.es: Esta a punto de suministrar mas del 50% de su saldo de {asset}. Considere mantener reservas para gas y emergencias.
message.pt: Voce esta prestes a fornecer mais de 50% do seu saldo de {asset}. Considere manter reservas para gas e emergencias.
message.zh: 您即将供应超过50%的 {asset} 余额。考虑保留一些用于gas费和紧急情况。
